findings.label: Notorious-phrase tests always skip on _DBMS_REUSE_SOURCE
findings.description: test_notorious_phrase_not_distractor_for_database_instance and test_notorious_phrase_not_distractor_for_dba have never asserted anything in any recorded run — both skipped in the reported output. The source contains the relevant sentences but the top-5 scorer doesn't consistently pick them. The tests are structurally honest (skipTest > silent pass) but provide zero runtime coverage of the notorious-phrase guard.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite both tests to call _build_mcq directly on the known target sentence rather than relying on _assemble_quiz scoring to select it. This makes them deterministic and reliably asserting.

findings.label: test_cross_question_reuse_bounded allows ≤2 reuses, not ≤1
findings.description: The conservative ≤2 bound is correct given pool-size arithmetic (9 candidates, 15 draws) and is documented in the test comment. No production bug — the bound cannot be tightened without expanding _DBMS_REUSE_SOURCE.
findings.recommendation: Expand _DBMS_REUSE_SOURCE to 20+ sentences in a follow-up and tighten the bound to assertLessEqual(count, 1) once the candidate pool exceeds 15.
